updates.title: Rebuilt Screenshot Tool as a persistent capture service
updates.summary: Replaced per-hotkey application startup with a persistent GTK4 service, then added precise frozen-region selection and exact identity matching for same-titled windows.
updates.previewAlt: Screenshot Tool frozen-region selector with live dimensions, keyboard guidance, crosshairs, and a magnified pointer view

updates.title: Built a local-first diagramming tool
updates.summary: Built a local-first visual editor where the browser and MCP tools work on the same JSON-backed diagram through one API and update the canvas in real time.
updates.previewAlt: Reconstructed early Diagram Tool interface zoomed out with Core API selected and its node properties open

updates.title: Built a shared history database for system activity
updates.summary: Built a PostgreSQL history store for tool operations and artifacts, with a normalized SQLAlchemy schema, repository API, and provenance queries.
updates.previewAlt: The first recorded Systems History Database output and its linked artifacts

capabilities.title: Design and connect multi-tool software systems
capabilities.summary: This temporary shell connects the registries, desktop services, data stores, reporting tools, and publishing systems that demonstrate this capability.

capabilities.title: Design durable data and evidence pipelines
capabilities.summary: This temporary shell connects capture-time storage, typed artifacts, shared history, editing, review, and publication into a durable evidence flow.

updates.title: Built a desktop service manager with live logs
updates.summary: Built a GTK dashboard for opted-in systemd user services, with cached live status, lifecycle controls, and a filterable shared journal stream.
updates.previewAlt: Reconstructed October 2025 GTK Process Manager showing grouped systemd services, lifecycle controls, and live journal logs

updates.title: Proposed a three stage project for applied AI integration
updates.summary: Turned an open-ended interest in applied AI into a three-stage engineering proposal, with practical prototypes, review points, documentation, and evaluation built into the plan.
updates.previewAlt: First page of the independent AI integration program proposal
